slices.focus: Kelli and Travis reopen a Coast Trip sinking fund after the pickup is paid down and finances gain breathing room.
slices.summary: With the pickup paid further down and month-end feeling less pinched, Kelli and Travis reopen a small sinking fund labeled 'Coast Trip'. They set a two-number threshold (one to seriously price it, a higher one to book it, including a buffer). Kelli defines raid rules (only true necessities) and an automatic monthly transfer. The fund itself becomes a relief marker — evidence that the household has moved from chaotic to forecastable.
